targets.rawSql: select overall_rank from manager_gameweek_history where team_id = (select team_id from managers limit 1) order by season desc, gameweek desc limit 1
select total_points from manager_gameweek_history where team_id = (select team_id from managers limit 1) order by season desc, gameweek desc limit 1

select p.web_name as player, t.short_name as team, sum(s.total_points) as points, sum(s.goals_scored) as goals, sum(s.assists) as assists from player_gameweek_stats s join players p on p.season = s.season and p.code = s.player_code join teams t on t.season = s.season and t.id = p.team_id where s.season = (select season from gameweeks where is_current = true limit 1) group by p.web_name, t.short_name order by points desc limit 15

select gameweek, points from manager_gameweek_history where team_id = (select team_id from managers limit 1) and season = (select season from gameweeks where is_current = true limit 1) order by gameweek

select p.web_name as player, t.short_name as team, mp.squad_position, mp.multiplier, mp.is_captain from manager_picks mp join players p on p.season = mp.season and p.id = mp.player_id join teams t on t.season = mp.season and t.id = p.team_id where mp.team_id = (select team_id from managers limit 1) and mp.gameweek = (select max(gameweek) from manager_gameweek_history where team_id = (select team_id from managers limit 1)) order by mp.squad_position
